name: Extract, transform, load (ETL)
short_description: A data integration pattern that extracts data from sources, transforms (cleans and shapes) it and loads it into a target such as a data warehouse. The variant ELT loads the data before transforming it.

evidence.quote: You'll hear two acronyms in this space ETL
ETL stands for extract, transform, load.
You might think ETL and ELT are coding terms for data engineers
Sin tuberías ETL y sin rediseño de esquemas
